content: Womu ɡe Dɑfidi u kuɑ. U nɛɛ,

content.text: Gusunɔ, nɑ sɔɔru sɑ̃ɑ.
Kon womu ko kɑ nɛn dwee yɑ̃nu, kɑ nɛn ɡɔ̃ru kpuro.
Nɛn mɔrɔku kɑ nɛn ɡuuru, i dom yɑndo,
kpɑ n womu ko yɑm sɑ̃reru.
Yinni Gusunɔ, kon nun siɑrɑ tɔmbun suunu sɔɔ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Kon nun womu kuɑ bwesenu sɔɔ.
Domi wunɛn tɔn ɡeerɑ kpɑ̃ tɑ wɔllu ɡirɑri.
Mɛyɑ mɑɑ wunɛn bɔrɔkinirɑ sɔ̃ɔsire sere ɡuru wirɔ.
Gusunɔ, ɑ seewo ɑ tii wɔlle suɑ.
Kpɑ wunɛn yiiko yu sɔ̃ɔsirɑ hɑnduniɑ kpuro sɔɔ.
Kpɑ ɑ wɑ ɑ kɑ bɛsɛ wunɛn kĩnɑsibu fɑɑbɑ ko.
A bɛsɛn kɑnɑru nɔɔwɔ kpɑ ɑ sun fɑɑbɑ ko kɑ wunɛn nɔm ɡeu.
Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ win sɑ̃ɑ yee dɛɛrɑrɔ u nɛɛ, u koo nɑsɑrɑ wɑ.
U koo Sikɛmu bɔnu ko kpɑ u tɔmbu Sukɔtun wɔwɑ yɑbuɑ.
Wiyɑ u Gɑlɑdi mɔ. Wiyɑ u mɑɑ Mɑnɑse mɔ.
Efɑrɑimu yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe win sii furɔ kɔkɔru.
Mɑ Yudɑ yɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɡe win sinɑ dɛkɑ.
Adɑmɑ Mɔɑbu yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ win woburutiɑ.
U koo Edɔmu bɑrɑ nɔɔ teu kɔ̃ɔwɑ u kɑ sɔ̃ɔsi mɑ yɑ kuɑ wiɡiɑ.
Kpɑ u nuku dobun kuuki ko Filisitibɑn tem sɔɔ.
Wɑrɑ u koo kɑ mɑn dɑ wuu ɡbɑ̃rɑruɡuu ɡen mi.
Wɑrɑ u koo mɑn kpɑrɑ u kɑ dɑ Edɔmuɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔ, wunɑ kɑɑ kɑ mɑn dɑ, wunɛ wi ɑ rɑɑ sun yinɑ,
mɑ ɑ ku rɑ mɑɑ kɑ bɛsɛn tɑbu kowobu yɑri.
A sun somiɔ su kɑ yɑri nɔni swɑ̃ɑrun di.
Tɔnun somiru tɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wom dirum.
À n wɑ̃ɑ kɑ bɛsɛ, sɑ ko kpĩ su tɑbu ko kɑ wɔruɡɔru.
Kpɑ ɑ bɛsɛn yibɛrɛbɑ kɔsuku.
